nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Green logistics solutions_qna_000
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: Why is it convenient to outsource green logistics activities to Third Party Logistics (3PL)?
nodes.answer: It is convenient to outsource green logistics activities to 3PL as they have achieved great maturity in sustainable practices (Evangelist et al., 2018).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Green logistics solutions_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: In what ways do suppliers' locations take precedence over environmental logistics considerations?
nodes.answer: Suppliers prioritize cost and distribution time when it comes to their locations, as these factors have a more direct impact on their operational efficiency compared to environmental logistics, which may not be as immediate of a concern.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Green logistics solutions_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How can the findings of Brown and Guiffrida (2014) be applied in logistics?
nodes.answer: The findings of Brown and Guiffrida (2014) can be applied in logistics to make more environmentally friendly transportation decisions.
